The '''MN-1 Groundcrawler''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] vehicle manufactured by [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]. The vehicle was three and a half [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and moved on treads. It could carry a crew of four and transport up to two hundred [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of cargo. [[Radell Mining Corporation]] utilized these vehicles.
